video.title: Dental AI Receptionist Demo | Answer More Calls & Book More Patients with AI
video.description:
Discover how AI Connect Pro for Dental Clinics helps dental practices answer more calls, book more appointments, reduce front-desk pressure and improve the patient experience with an intelligent AI Receptionist and Dental Practice Dashboard.

In this demo, we show how AI Connect Pro can support a busy dental clinic by handling incoming calls, patient enquiries, appointment bookings, recalls, conversations and follow-up — while giving practice owners and managers clear visibility across clinic operations.

See how the Dental Dashboard helps monitor:

AI calls answered and appointments booked
New patient enquiries and treatment opportunities
Appointment confirmations, cancellations and no-show risk
AI Receptionist call outcomes and urgent enquiries
SMS, Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp conversations
Recall and patient reactivation opportunities
Treatment pipeline value
Chair utilisation and provider capacity
Clinic performance and reporting

The goal isn’t to replace your reception team. It’s to give them more capacity to focus on patients while AI handles more of the repetitive front-desk workload.

If your dental practice is dealing with missed calls, reception overload, slow follow-up, appointment gaps or lost patient enquiries, an AI Receptionist can help make sure more opportunities are captured and acted on.

Call AI Connect Pro and hear it work for yourself.

1300 142 702

More calls answered. More patients booked. More time for what matters.
